seoDescription.en: A terracotta relief of a child's head signed RIZAL, this replica reflects Rizal's portrait sculpture from his Dapitan exile.

images.alt: Terracotta relief of a child's head, signed RIZAL, mounted on white backing in a red velvet frame
Detail of the relief's neck and the carved RIZAL signature on the white backing
Close view of the child's face, showing the closed eyes and modeled nose and lips
Top-down view of the head mounted on its white backing, with the RIZAL signature and red velvet frame
High-angle view of the child's face within the red velvet frame
